message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from a local filesystem path with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check of any kind.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only removes rows with missing target values and displays the price range, but performs no validation of label distributions, expected value ranges, or label-noise detection tools.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code removes duplicates and missing values but performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples to guard against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains a new XGBRegressor from scratch and does not load any pretrained weights or serialized model, so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, pinned revision) is performed or needed — but no such control exists.
No detected label distribution validation: The code only removes missing targets and duplicates, but never checks label distribution, class balance, or detects anomalous label values before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, trigger detection, or any other backdoor defense mechanism anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a standard XGBRegressor with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The evaluation uses only cross-validation on the full dataset with a single metric (MAE), with no held-out test set isolated from training, no signed/hashed evaluation data, and no multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: User inputs (car index, feature values for prediction) are taken via raw `input()` calls and cast directly without range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input handling.
No detected output bounds checks: The model's predicted price is used/displayed without any NaN guard, negativity check, or plausibility bound against the known price range.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is an XGBoost tabular regressor, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
